'''Earthbound tecpatl''' are a two-handed [[Weapons/Categories#Stab sword|stab sword]] that require level 55 [[Attack]] to wield, obtained as a rare drop from [[earthen nagua]] in the [[Tonali Cavern]]. Like their crush and slash equivalents, the [[glacial temotli]] and [[sulphur blades]], it performs [[Multi-hit weapons|two independently rolled hits per attack]]. The maximum damage of each hit is determined by calculating the combined max hit as normal and dividing it by two. If the combined max hit is odd, one max hit is rounded up while the other is rounded down (e.g., 45 → 22 + 23). As a [[Multi-hit weapons|multi-hit weapon]], it is especially useful against monsters that have negative [[flat armour]], such as [[Nagua]], since all successful hits will do an extra damage to them.
